apps.name: 人妻攻略模拟器
apps.description:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>人妻攻略模拟器</title>
    <style>
        *{box-sizing:border-box}
        body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,Cantarell,"Open Sans","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;margin:0;padding:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1a2e 0%,#16213e 50%,#0f0f1a 100%);color:#e0e0e0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;animation:fadeIn 0.6s ease}
        @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
        h1{text-align:center;margin:1.5rem 0 0.5rem;color:#ff69b4;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,105,180,0.5),0 0 40px rgba(255,105,180,0.3);font-size:1.8rem;letter-spacing:2px}
        .subtitle{text-align:center;color:#888;font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
        h2,h3{text-align:center;margin:1.2rem 0;color:#ff69b4;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,105,180,0.6)}
        hr{border:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#ff69b4,transparent);margin:1.5rem 10%}
        main{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1rem;flex:1}
        .section{background:rgba(30,30,50,0.8);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);border-radius:16px;padding:1.8rem;margin:1.5rem 0;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(147,0,255,0.15);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
        .tabs{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.8rem;margin:1.5rem 0}
        .tab-btn{position:relative;z-index:2;background:rgba(42,26,58,0.8);color:#ff69b4;border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);padding:0.8rem 1.6rem;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;transition:all 0.3s;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);user-select:none}
        .tab-btn:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.8);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(186,85,211,0.4);border-color:#ff69b4}
        .tab-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c71585,#ff69b4);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,105,180,0.5);border-color:transparent}
        .tab-btn:focus{outline:2px solid #ff69b4;outline-offset:2px}
        .tab-content{display:none;animation:slideIn 0.4s ease}
        .tab-content.active{display:block}
        @keyframes slideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
        .intro{text-align:center;line-height:1.8;font-size:1.05rem;color:#ccc}
        .quick-start-btn{display:block;margin:1.5rem auto 0;padding:1rem 2.5rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff69b4,#c71585);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s;box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(255,105,180,0.4);user-select:none}
        .quick-start-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05) translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(255,105,180,0.6)}
        .form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0}
        .form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
        .form-group label{font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.5rem;color:#ff69b4;font-size:0.95rem}
        .form-group input,.form-group textarea,.form-group select{padding:0.8rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(106,27,154,0.5);background:rgba(30,30,46,0.9);color:#e0e0e0;font-size:1rem;transition:all 0.3s}
        .form-group input:focus,.form-group textarea:focus,.form-group select:focus{outline:none;border-color:#ff69b4;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,105,180,0.2),0 0 20px rgba(255,105,180,0.1)}
        .form-group input:hover,.form-group textarea:hover,.form-group select:hover{border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.5)}
        .radio-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.8rem;margin:0.5rem 0;padding:1rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(106,27,154,0.5);background:rgba(30,30,46,0.9)}
        .radio-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.6rem;cursor:pointer;padding:0.5rem;border-radius:8px;transition:background 0.2s}
        .radio-item:hover{background:rgba(255,105,180,0.1)}
        .radio-item input{margin-top:0.35rem;accent-color:#ff69b4}
        .radio-item label{margin:0;color:#ccc;font-weight:normal;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.5}
        .gender-options{display:flex;gap:1.5rem;align-items:center;margin-top:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
        .gender-options label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;font-weight:normal;color:#e0e0e0;cursor:pointer;padding:0.5rem 1rem;border-radius:20px;transition:all 0.2s;border:1px solid transparent}
        .gender-options label:hover{background:rgba(255,105,180,0.15);border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.3)}
        .gender-options input[type="radio"]{margin:0;accent-color:#ff69b4}
        .preview-container{margin:1.5rem 0}
        .preview-title{color:#ff69b4;font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem}
        .preview-title::before{content:"📋"}
        .preview-box{background:rgba(17,17,17,0.9);border:2px solid;border-image:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff69b4,#c71585,#ff69b4) 1;border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;min-height:120px;white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffb6c1;font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.6;animation:borderGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;position:relative}
        @keyframes borderGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,105,180,0.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(255,105,180,0.6),0 0 50px rgba(199,21,133,0.3)}}
        .btn-group{display:flex;gap:1rem;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.5rem}
        .copy-btn,.reset-btn{padding:0.9rem 2rem;border:none;border-radius:50px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;user-select:none}
        .copy-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c71585,#ff69b4);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(199,21,133,0.4)}
        .copy-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05) translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(199,21,133,0.5)}
        .copy-btn.success{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#059669);box-shadow:0 5px 20px rgba(16,185,129,0.4)}
        .reset-btn{background:rgba(60,60,80,0.8);color:#ccc;border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3)}
        .reset-btn:hover{background:rgba(80,80,100,0.8);color:#fff;border-color:#ff69b4}
        #success-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:1000;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
        .modal-content{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e1e2e,#2a2a4a);border:2px solid #ff69b4;border-radius:20px;padding:2.5rem;max-width:400px;text-align:center;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(255,105,180,0.3);animation:modalPop 0.3s ease}
        @keyframes modalPop{from{transform:scale(0.8);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
        .modal-content h3{color:#ff69b4;margin-top:0}
        .modal-content p{color:#ccc}
        .close-modal{position:absolute;top:15px;right:20px;font-size:1.8rem;cursor:pointer;color:#ff69b4;transition:transform 0.2s}
        .close-modal:hover{transform:rotate(90deg)}
        footer{text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;background:rgba(10,10,20,0.9);color:#666;font-size:0.85rem;margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.2)}
        footer a{color:#ff69b4;text-decoration:none;transition:color 0.2s}
        footer a:hover{color:#fff}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(30,30,46,0.65);border-radius:8px}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff69b4,#c71585);border-radius:8px}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#ff9ecb}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-corner{background:transparent}
        *{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#ff69b4 rgba(30,30,46,0.65)}
        textarea::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
        .changelog-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
        #other-fields{display:none}
        #custom:has(input[name="gender"][value="其他"]:checked) #other-fields,
        #custom:has(.gender-options label:nth-of-type(4) input:checked) #other-fields{display:block}
        .gender-specific{display:none;animation:fadeIn 0.3s ease}
        .gender-specific.active{display:block}
        .divider{grid-column:1/-1;border:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,rgba(106,27,154,0.5),transparent);margin:0.8rem 0}
        .section-title{grid-column:1/-1;color:#ff69b4;font-size:0.85rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:0.5rem;padding-bottom:0.5rem;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,105,180,0.3);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem}
        ul{text-align:left;line-height:1.8;padding-left:1.5rem}
        ul li{margin:0.8rem 0;color:#ccc}
        ul li strong{color:#ff69b4}
        .emoji-icon{font-size:1.2rem}
        .mode-selector{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:0.8rem}
        .mode-btn{background:rgba(42,26,58,0.8);border:2px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 0.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s;text-align:center;user-select:none;min-height:100px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
        .mode-btn:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.6);border-color:#ff69b4;transform:translateY(-2px)}
        .mode-btn.selected{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(199,21,133,0.4),rgba(255,105,180,0.3));border-color:#ff69b4;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,105,180,0.3)}
        .world-item,.style-item{position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:all 0.3s ease}
        .world-item::before,.style-item::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,0.2),transparent);transition:left 0.5s}
        .world-item:hover::before,.style-item:hover::before{left:100%}
        .world-item.selected,.style-item.selected{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(199,21,133,0.7),rgba(255,105,180,0.6));border-color:#ff69b4;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,105,180,0.6),0 0 60px rgba(199,21,133,0.3),inset 0 0 20px rgba(255,105,180,0.2);transform:scale(1.05)}
        .world-item.selected .world-name,.style-item.selected .style-name{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)}
        .world-item.selected .world-desc,.style-item.selected .style-desc{color:#ffb6c1}
        .world-item:hover,.style-item:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.6);border-color:#ff69b4;transform:translateY(-2px)}
        .mode-btn input{display:none}
        .mode-btn .mode-icon{font-size:1.8rem;display:block;margin-bottom:0.5rem}
        .mode-btn .mode-name{color:#ff69b4;font-weight:bold;font-size:0.9rem}
        .mode-btn .mode-desc{color:#999;font-size:0.7rem;margin-top:0.3rem}
        .custom-mode-input{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:0.8rem;display:none}
        .custom-mode-input.active{display:block}
        .custom-mode-input textarea{width:100%;padding:1rem;border-radius:10px;border:2px dashed rgba(255,105,180,0.5);background:rgba(255,105,180,0.08);color:#e0e0e0;font-size:1rem;resize:vertical;min-height:80px}
        .custom-mode-input textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:#ff69b4;background:rgba(255,105,180,0.12)}
        .custom-mode-input textarea::placeholder{color:#888}
        .difficulty-selector{display:flex;gap:0.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
        .diff-btn{flex:1;min-width:80px;background:rgba(42,26,58,0.8);border:2px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);border-radius:10px;padding:0.7rem 0.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s;text-align:center;user-select:none}
        .diff-btn:hover{border-color:#ff69b4;transform:translateY(-2px)}
        .diff-btn.selected{border-color:#ff69b4;box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(255,105,180,0.4)}
        .diff-btn.selected.story{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(139,92,246,0.3),rgba(124,58,237,0.2))}
        .diff-btn.selected.easy{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(16,185,129,0.3),rgba(5,150,105,0.2))}
        .diff-btn.selected.normal{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(245,158,11,0.3),rgba(217,119,6,0.2))}
        .diff-btn.selected.hard{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(239,68,68,0.3),rgba(185,28,28,0.2))}
        .diff-btn.selected.hell{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(127,29,29,0.5),rgba(0,0,0,0.3))}
        .diff-btn.selected.extreme{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(220,38,38,0.4),rgba(127,29,29,0.3));border-color:#dc2626!important}
        .diff-btn input{display:none}
        .diff-btn .diff-icon{font-size:1.3rem}
        .diff-btn .diff-name{font-weight:bold;margin-top:0.3rem;font-size:0.85rem}
        .diff-btn.story .diff-name{color:#a78bfa}
        .diff-btn.easy .diff-name{color:#10b981}
        .diff-btn.normal .diff-name{color:#f59e0b}
        .diff-btn.hard .diff-name{color:#ef4444}
        .diff-btn.hell .diff-name{color:#991b1b}
        .diff-btn.extreme .diff-name{color:#ef4444}
        .diff-btn .diff-desc{font-size:0.65rem;color:#888;margin-top:0.2rem}
        .xp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:0.8rem}
        .xp-item{background:rgba(42,26,58,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.2);border-radius:10px;padding:0.8rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6rem;user-select:none}
        .xp-item:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.4);border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.5)}
        .xp-item.checked{background:rgba(199,21,133,0.3);border-color:#ff69b4}
        .xp-item input{accent-color:#ff69b4;cursor:pointer;width:18px;height:18px}
        .xp-item span{color:#ccc;font-size:0.95rem}
        .xp-item.checked span{color:#ff69b4}
        .route-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:0.8rem}
        .route-item{background:rgba(42,26,58,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.2);border-radius:10px;padding:0.8rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6rem;user-select:none}
        .route-item:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.4);border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.5)}
        .route-item.checked{background:rgba(199,21,133,0.3);border-color:#ff69b4}
        .route-item input{accent-color:#ff69b4;cursor:pointer;width:18px;height:18px}
        .route-item .route-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
        .route-item .route-name{color:#ccc;font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:bold}
        .route-item .route-desc{color:#888;font-size:0.75rem;margin-top:0.2rem}
        .route-item.checked .route-name{color:#ff69b4}
        .fetish-tag-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:0.6rem;margin-top:0.8rem}
        .fetish-tag{background:rgba(42,26,58,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.2);border-radius:8px;padding:0.6rem 0.8rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s;text-align:center;color:#ccc;font-size:0.9rem;user-select:none}
        .fetish-tag:hover{background:rgba(74,20,140,0.4);border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.5)}
        .fetish-tag.active{background:rgba(199,21,133,0.3);border-color:#ff69b4;color:#ff69b4;font-weight:bold}
        .target-wife-box{background:rgba(30,30,46,0.9);border:1px solid rgba(106,27,154,0.5);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;margin-top:0.5rem}
        .target-wife-box .form-grid{margin:0;gap:1rem}
        .feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:1rem;margin:1.5rem 0}
        .feature-card{background:rgba(42,26,58,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.2);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;text-align:center;transition:all 0.3s}
        .feature-card:hover{border-color:#ff69b4;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(255,105,180,0.2)}
        .feature-card .icon{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem}
        .feature-card .title{color:#ff69b4;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.3rem}
        .feature-card .desc{color:#999;font-size:0.85rem}
        .route-showcase{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:0.8rem;margin:1rem 0}
        .route-tag{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(199,21,133,0.2),rgba(255,105,180,0.1));border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);border-radius:20px;padding:0.6rem 1rem;text-align:center;color:#ffb6c1;font-size:0.9rem;transition:all 0.2s;user-select:none}
        .route-tag:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(199,21,133,0.4),rgba(255,105,180,0.2));border-color:#ff69b4;color:#fff}
        .character-card{background:rgba(30,30,46,0.9);border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:1.5rem;margin:1rem 0}
        .character-card .char-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,105,180,0.3)}
        .character-card .char-icon{font-size:2.5rem}
        .character-card .char-name{color:#ff69b4;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:bold}
        .character-card .char-title{color:#888;font-size:0.85rem}
        .character-card .char-desc{color:#ccc;line-height:1.8}
        .character-card .char-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;margin-top:1rem}
        .character-card .char-tag{background:rgba(255,105,180,0.15);color:#ff69b4;padding:0.3rem 0.8rem;border-radius:15px;font-size:0.8rem}
        .select-with-custom{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
        .custom-text-input{background:rgba(255,105,180,0.1)!important;border-color:rgba(255,105,180,0.5)!important;margin-top:0.5rem}
        .custom-text-input:focus{border-color:#ff69b4!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,105,180,0.3)!important}
        .custom-input-section{grid-column:1/-1;background:rgba(255,105,180,0.05);border:1px dashed rgba(255,105,180,0.4);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;margin-top:0.5rem}
        .custom-input-section label{color:#ff69b4;font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem}
        .custom-input-section textarea{width:100%;padding:1rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.3);background:rgba(30,30,46,0.9);color:#e0e0e0;font-size:1rem;resize:vertical;min-height:70px}
        .custom-input-section textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:#ff69b4;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,105,180,0.2)}
        .custom-input-section .hint{color:#888;font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:0.5rem;line-height:1.5}
        .custom-box{background:rgba(255,105,180,0.08);border:1px dashed rgba(255,105,180,0.4);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
        .custom-box h4{color:#ff69b4;margin:0 0 0.8rem 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem}
        .custom-box p{color:#aaa;font-size:0.9rem;margin:0 0 1rem 0;line-height:1.6}
        .custom-box ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.2rem}
        .custom-box ul li{color:#ccc;font-size:0.9rem;margin:0.4rem 0}
        .highlight-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,105,180,0.15),rgba(199,21,133,0.1));border:2px solid rgba(255,105,180,0.4);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem;margin:1rem 0;text-align:center}
        .highlight-box .highlight-icon{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem}
        .highlight-box .highlight-title{color:#ff69b4;font-weight:bold;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem}
        .highlight-box .highlight-desc{color:#ccc;font-size:0.95rem}
        .author-note{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(30,30,50,0.95),rgba(42,26,58,0.9));border:2px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.4);border-radius:16px;padding:1.5rem;margin:1.5rem 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
        .author-note::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ffd700,#ff69b4,#ffd700,transparent)}
        .author-note h3{color:#ffd700;margin:0 0 1rem 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;font-size:1.1rem}
        .author-note-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1rem}
        .author-note-item{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem;border-left:3px solid #ff69b4}
        .author-note-item h4{color:#ff69b4;margin:0 0 0.6rem 0;font-size:0.95rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem}
        .author-note-item p{color:#ccc;margin:0;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.6}
        .author-note-item ul{margin:0.5rem 0 0 0;padding-left:1.2rem}
